summary:
Frontend-only end-to-end test of the NEW 'SA CoParents Legal Lens Review and Report to Court' feature. All acceptance criteria pass EXCEPT one data-driven note: with casekit.completed_case (alpha/beta answers), joint findings returns no differences so lens-alignment_disagreements + lens-partial_alignment + lens-joint_gaps are empty on prefill (still fine per code, but spec text 'lens-alignment_disagreements prefilled non-empty' is not guaranteed for this fixture). Verified against a completed education case (pro=t_011a8377@example.com, rid=8abe8341-cfd9-42c0-8120-7a4bcf01c138, password testpass123).

(1) /joint/{rid} — legal-lens-card renders with lens-readiness-list containing lens-ready-assessment_a/assessment_b/joint (green checkmark, 'Received'/'Joint Report Received'), and lens-ready-fv_a/fv_b unchecked with '(N/A)' suffix. legal-lens-prepare-btn navigates to /cases/{rid}/professional-report.

(2) Builder page: lens-title exact 'SA CoParents Legal Lens Review and Report to Court'; lens-steps has exactly 13 items; lens-status='Draft'; lens-case-id='SA-26-EDU-4EB6DR' read-only; lens-parent_a_name='Parent A'; lens-professional-name='Pro' read-only; lens-alignment_agreements prefilled (571 chars, non-empty); lens-joint-rating-value shows '10' (prefilled suggestion, number).

(3) Safety: clicking lens-fv-a-received + lens-fv-b-received flips lens-fv-both to '✓ Both Assessments Received'; lens-joint-process-yes selectable; lens-safety-note contains 'Safety findings may alter or override ordinary co-parenting, mediation, communication, or joint-process recommendations.'

(4) Parent A rating slider (using React native input setter): setting to 2 → first lens-band shows '1-2: Crisis / High Conflict' with 'highly reactive communication' in the gaps list. Setting to 9 → band shows '9-10: Child-Centered Partnership' with 'supports child\'s relationship with other parent'. Ticking 'Additional Counselor / Provider' checkbox reveals lens-parent-a-provider with -name/-specialty/-contact inputs, all fillable.

(5) Joint: rating slider set to 4 → last lens-band shows '3-4: Restricted / Reactive' and 'Mode: Restricted Parallel Parenting'. lens-guidance lists 'parent facilitation', 'Children in the Middle', 'BIFF', 'parallel-parenting structure', 'structured app communication'. lens-rating-note contains 'does not automatically determine the process'.

(6) Joint resources: ticking 'Additional Expert / Provider' reveals lens-joint-provider; ticking Conflict 'Parent Facilitation' works; textareas short_term_goals/long_term_goals/professional_summary/alignment_summary fillable.

(7) lens-finalize-btn disabled while lens-signature_name empty. lens-save-btn → toast 'Draft saved'. After reload, all values persist: parent-a-rating, joint-rating, provider fields, and both 'Parent Facilitation' and 'Additional Expert / Provider' checkboxes.

(8) Fill lens-signature_name='QA Pro' + lens-professional_title='Mediator' → lens-finalize-btn enabled. Clicking → toast 'Report marked Final'; lens-status='Final'; lens-finalized visible showing 'Date finalized: 2026-09-20'. GET /api/cases/{rid}/professional-report/pdf → 200 application/pdf.

(9) lens-preview-btn toggles lens-preview-frame iframe on; button text becomes 'Back to Editor'; clicking again hides frame.

(10) lens-status-select changed to 'Submitted to Court' → status pill updates to 'Submitted to Court' with toast.

(11) /professional-report: professional-report-title exact 'SA CoParents Legal Lens Review and Report to Court'; professional-report-cases lists the case; professional-report-case-{rid} contains 'Submitted to Court' pill and lens-readiness-list; professional-report-open-{rid} link navigates to builder.

(12) Parent A login on same case: GET /api/cases/{rid}/professional-report returns 403; /cases/{rid}/professional-report renders 'Approved professional access required.' toast/error, page does not crash.

(13) Mobile 390px on builder: document.body.scrollWidth==window.innerWidth==390, NO horizontal overflow.
action_items: Optional: casekit.completed_case fills both parents with near-identical themes ('alpha' vs 'beta'), which joint_findings sees as fully aligned → lens-alignment_disagreements/partial_alignment/joint_gaps end up empty in prefill. Not a code bug (backend join is correct), but if the spec text 'alignment_disagreements prefilled non-empty' is a hard requirement, seed a case with more divergent answers to exercise that field.
critical_code_review_comments: LegalLensReport.jsx line 49 debounced auto-PUT only sends rating fields on rating change and returns new classification, which is fine, but no similar debounced save exists for other fields — every non-rating edit relies on explicit Save Draft. Consider a light autosave for parity with other builder pages.

LegalLensReport.jsx Field/Radio/Checks/Provider testids: multiple resource checkboxes share a single data-testid pattern (e.g. every 'Additional Counselor / Provider' checkbox row still uses lens-parent-a-resource / lens-joint-resource for all 7/8 items) making it hard to target individual options in playwright — currently we fall back to label text. Consider deriving a slug per option.

prefill() in legal_lens.py depends on _pick to seed parent_a_strengths etc; if the parent answered with empty strings _pick returns None but the field is still set (dict update). Confirm null handling on frontend Field component (it uses value || '' so fine).

PDF endpoint is behind cookie auth and works when opened in an <a href>+download from same origin — good. But because preview uses the same route inside an <iframe>, if the browser blocks third-party cookies for the iframe (some Safari settings) the preview may show 'Preview Unavailable'. Consider a signed short-lived preview URL.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of behavioral acceptance criteria; 1 data-fixture caveat on non-empty disagreements

seed_data_creation: One completed education case via /app/backend/tests/seed_iter54.py (casekit.completed_case). Seed persisted to /tmp/iter54_seed.json.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Slider inputs must be driven with the native HTMLInputElement value setter to fire React onChange (Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set). Auth submit selector is data-testid='auth-submit-btn' (not get_by_role('button', name='Sign In') — that also matches the 'login-tab' pill). Legal Lens routes: /joint/{rid} (card), /cases/{rid}/professional-report (builder), /professional-report (case picker home). PDF served at /api/cases/{rid}/professional-report/pdf; parents get 403 from /api/cases/{rid}/professional-report.
rca of the issue: No app-side bug. Spec statement about 'alignment_disagreements prefilled non-empty' is contingent on the two parents' answers differing enough for joint_findings() in legal_lens.py to record entries in f['differences']. casekit.fill() writes deliberately similar answers ('alpha'/'beta' theme), which land in the alignment bucket → differences=[] → three affected fields (joint_gaps, alignment_disagreements, partial_alignment) come back '' from prefill. Fix (if needed) at the fixture level, not the app.
